whenToUse: An architecture, interiors or design studio presenting projects as captioned plates and drawings.
Practices that need a filterable project register, awards and a studio page.
avoidWhen: Photographers with an image wall — use site-portfolio-01.
Marketing or creative agencies selling services — use site-agency-01.
a11y: Filters expose aria-pressed, the active caption uses aria-current, and motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
The G-key grid overlay is decorative; avoid documenting it as a required interaction.
